data.name: FailureGenericTitle
data.value: Startup failed

data.name: FailureUnknownRemedy
data.value: This build has no named handling for this failure. Report the SemiPlot log file, which carries the full entry.

data.name: FailureThrownTitle
data.value: Startup failed unexpectedly

data.name: FailureThrownDetail
data.value: The startup sequence ended with {0}: {1}

data.name: FailureThrownRemedy
data.value: This build has no named handling for this failure. Report the SemiPlot log file, which carries the entry and its stack trace.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileNotFoundTitle
data.value: Connection file not found

data.name: FailureConnectionFileNotFoundDetail
data.value: SemiPlot looked for the archive connection file at '{0}' and found nothing there.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileNotFoundRemedy
data.value: Create that file, or start SemiPlot with --config-dir naming the directory that holds it.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileRejectedTitle
data.value: Connection file cannot be read

data.name: FailureConnectionFileRejectedDetail
data.value: The connection file '{0}' exists but was rejected: {1}

data.name: FailureConnectionFileRejectedRemedy
data.value: Correct the file at the path above; the reason names what was rejected.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileUnreadableRemedy
data.value: Give the account running SemiPlot read access to the file and close whatever holds it open.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileUnparseableRemedy
data.value: Repair the YAML syntax of the file; the reason above names the position that failed.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileMissingFieldRemedy
data.value: Add the field the reason names to the file. Every field of the format is required.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileOutOfRangeRemedy
data.value: Correct the value the reason names to one inside the range it states.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileUnknownTimeZoneRemedy
data.value: Set the time zone to an identifier this machine knows: IANA, or the id 'tzutil /g' prints.

data.name: FailureArchiveUnreachableTitle
data.value: No connection to the archive

data.name: FailureArchiveUnreachableDetail
data.value: SemiPlot could not open a connection to {0}.

data.name: FailureArchiveUnreachableRemedy
data.value: Check that the PostgreSQL server is running and that the host and port in the connection file are reachable from this machine: route, firewall and the server's listen address.

data.name: FailureArchiveAccessDeniedTitle
data.value: The archive refused the credentials

data.name: FailureArchiveAccessDeniedDetail
data.value: The server at {0} answered, but refused user '{1}' on '{2}'.

data.name: FailureArchiveAccessDeniedRemedy
data.value: Correct the user name and password in the connection file, or grant that role SELECT on the archive tables. The network is not the problem. Leave the host and port alone.

data.name: FailureArchiveNotProvisionedTitle
data.value: The archive is not provisioned

data.name: FailureArchiveDatabaseMissingDetail
data.value: The server at {0} answers, but holds no database '{1}'.

data.name: FailureArchiveDatabaseMissingRemedy
data.value: Run 'semibase site' against this server to provision the database, or correct the database name in the connection file.

data.name: FailureArchiveTableMissingDetail
data.value: The archive {0} holds no table '{1}'.

data.name: FailureArchiveTableMissingRemedy
data.value: Table '{0}' is created by provisioning. Run 'semibase site' against this database to finish provisioning it.

data.name: FailureArchiveConnectionLostTitle
data.value: The archive stopped answering

data.name: FailureArchiveConnectionLostDetail
data.value: The live edge of {0} stopped answering after {1} consecutive failed reads. The history already drawn is unaffected.

data.name: FailureArchiveConnectionLostRemedy
data.value: Check that the PostgreSQL server is still running and still reachable from this machine. SemiPlot keeps polling and clears this by itself once the archive answers again.

data.name: FailureArchiveShapeUnexpectedTitle
data.value: The archive has an unexpected shape

data.name: FailureArchiveShapeUnexpectedDetail
data.value: The archive {0} holds the tables SemiPlot reads, but not the columns they are expected to carry. The server answered: {1}

data.name: FailureArchiveShapeUnexpectedRemedy
data.value: Table 'public.trends' and its columns are created by provisioning. Run 'semibase site' against this database to bring it to the shape this build reads, and check that nothing else has altered the table since.

data.name: FailureArchiveQueryTimedOutTitle
data.value: The archive ended the read

data.name: FailureArchiveQueryTimedOutDetail
data.value: The read of {0} was ended by the server (SQLSTATE 57014).

data.name: FailureArchiveQueryTimedOutRemedy
data.value: Check statement_timeout for the reader role on the server and raise it, or narrow the window SemiPlot opens on; if the bound is not the cause, check whether an administrator cancelled the read.

data.name: FailureArchiveReadFailedTitle
data.value: The archive rejected the read

data.name: FailureArchiveReadFailedDetail
data.value: The archive {0} rejected the read (SQLSTATE {1}).

data.name: FailureArchiveReadFailedRemedy
data.value: This build has no named handling for SQLSTATE {0}. Find the matching entry in the PostgreSQL server log and report it with the SemiPlot log file.

data.name: FailureArchiveReadUnnamedDetail
data.value: The read of {0} failed before the server answered, so it carries no SQLSTATE.

data.name: FailureArchiveReadUnnamedRemedy
data.value: The failure came from the client side. Report the SemiPlot log file, which carries the exception this build could not name.

data.name: FailureStartupReadTimedOutTitle
data.value: The archive did not answer in time

data.name: FailureStartupReadTimedOutDetail
data.value: The startup read of the {0} did not answer within {1} s. SemiPlot stopped waiting; the query is still running on the server.

data.name: FailureStartupReadTimedOutRemedy
data.value: The connection was accepted, so the host and port are right. Check whether the server is overloaded and whether the archive is indexed on its time column.

data.name: FailureStartupReadPenCatalogue
data.value: pen catalogue

data.name: FailureStartupReadArchiveExtent
data.value: archive extent

data.name: FailureAppSettingsNotFoundTitle
data.value: Interface settings file not found

data.name: FailureAppSettingsNotFoundDetail
data.value: SemiPlot looked for the interface settings file at '{0}' and found nothing there.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsNotFoundRemedy
data.value: Create that file with a 'locale' and a 'theme' key, or start SemiPlot with --config-dir naming the directory that holds it.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsRejectedTitle
data.value: Interface settings file cannot be read

data.name: FailureAppSettingsUnreadableDetail
data.value: The interface settings file '{0}' exists but could not be read or parsed.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsUnreadableRemedy
data.value: Give the account running SemiPlot read access to the file and repair its YAML syntax.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsKeyMissingDetail
data.value: The interface settings file '{0}' carries no '{1}' key.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsKeyMissingRemedy
data.value: Add the key the detail names to the file. Both keys of the format are required.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsValueInvalidDetail
data.value: The interface settings file '{0}' holds a '{1}' outside its values. Accepted: {2}.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsValueInvalidRemedy
data.value: Set that key to one of the accepted values and restart SemiPlot.
